name: Agent Teams for RM — Market Data Agent
description: Provides live stock prices, day change %, 52-week range, volume, and market indices (Nifty 50, Sensex) for NSE/BSE listed securities. Runs on AWS Bedrock AgentCore (us-east-1). Auth: AWS SigV4.

skills.name: Get Live Stock Price
skills.description: Returns current price, day change %, 52-week high/low, and volume for NSE/BSE listed stocks.
examples: What is the current price of RELIANCE on NSE?

skills.name: Get Market Indices
skills.description: Returns current values and day change for Nifty 50, Sensex, Nifty Bank, and Nifty IT.
examples: How is the market doing today?
